story: Sara and Ivan are at a big party for a social club. They meet a new lady and talk about people from around the world. They learn about the different members in their group.
title: The Club Party
setting: A bright room with many people and colorful decorations.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: A young woman with long brown hair and a green dress.

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: A tall man with short black hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Maya
characters.look: An older lady with silver hair and a yellow scarf.

sentences.en: Sara and Ivan go to a big party.
sentences.zh: Sara和Ivan去参加一个大型聚会。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara with long brown hair and Ivan with short black hair walk into a room with colorful decorations.

sentences.en: The room is full of every interesting person.
sentences.zh: 房间里到处都是有趣的人。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many people are talking and laughing in a bright room.

sentences.en: A kind lady talks to them there.
sentences.zh: 一位和蔼的女士在那里和他们交谈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya with silver hair and a yellow scarf smiles at Sara and Ivan.

sentences.en: She is a member of this club.
sentences.zh: 她是这个俱乐部的成员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya points to a small badge on her yellow scarf.

sentences.en: She has a married daughter in Australia.
sentences.zh: 她有一个在澳大利亚的已婚女儿。
sentences.scene_prompt: Maya shows a small photo of a woman to Sara.

sentences.en: The group has many different nationalities.
sentences.zh: 这个团体有很多不同的国籍。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large group of diverse people stands together in a circle.

sentences.en: Every adult man and woman is welcome.
sentences.zh: 每一位成年男子和女士都受到欢迎。
sentences.scene_prompt: A man and a woman shake hands in the middle of the room.

sentences.en: Age does not matter to this group.
sentences.zh: 年龄对这个团体来说并不重要。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young man and an old man are laughing together.

sentences.en: Anyone can join this group in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上任何人都能够加入这个团体。
sentences.scene_prompt: A man holds a sign that shows a picture of the earth.

sentences.en: They have a good feeling about it.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan are smiling happily at the party.

sentences.en: They met many people once before.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan look at a photo album of people.
